allow: PowerShell($m = Get-Content data\\mods.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $m | Group-Object Category | Select Name,Count | Format-Table; $m | ? { $_.name -eq 'Glyphic' } | select id,category,gen,family,level,text,@{n='w';e={$_.weights | ConvertTo-Json -Compress}} | Format-List; $m | ? { $_.category -eq 'essence' } | select -First 3 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $m | ? { $_.category -eq 'perfect_essence' } | select -First 2 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5)

PowerShell($e = Get-Content data\\essences.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $e.Count; $e | select -First 2 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $e | Group-Object tier | select Name,Count | ft; $a = Get-Content data\\alloys.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $a.Count; $a | select -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5; $m = Get-Content data\\mods.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $ess = $m | ? { $_.category -in 'essence','perfect_essence' }; "essence mods with >1 page: " + \($ess | ? { \($_.weights.PSObject.Properties | measure\).Count -gt 1 } | measure\).Count; "distinct essence names in mods: " + \($ess.name | sort -Unique | measure\).Count; "essence names not in mods: "; \($e.name + $a.name\) | ? { $_ -notin $ess.name })

PowerShell($c = Get-Content data\\currencies.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $c | ? op | select name,op,minModLevel,maxItemLevel,@{n='rin';e={$_.rarityIn -join '/'}},target | ft -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250; $o = Get-Content data\\omens.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $o | ? crafting | select name,targetCurrency,effect | ft -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250; \(Get-Content data\\item_classes.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json\) | select name,slot,group,@{n='p';e={$_.modPages -join ','}} | ft -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 250)
